meta.description: The CNFS car project - technical specifications, cost breakdown, timeline, and engineering goals.
meta.ogDescription: Our car: EMRAX 228 engine, <210kg, built from scratch by students at Centrale Nantes.

props.title: Project Falcon
body: An electric single-seat race car — Project Falcon — designed and built entirely by students at Centrale Nantes.

Powered by an EMRAX 228 electric motor on a tubular steel chassis with double-wishbone suspension, 13" Hoosier tyres on magnesium rims, and an LSD differential. No aerodynamic package for Year 1 — pure mechanical grip.
Our target: enter concept class at Formula Student France (Transpolis), August 2026.
props.imageAlt: EMRAX 228 electric motor — the heart of Project Falcon

props.label: Financials
props.title: Cost Breakdown
props.intro: Detailed component-by-component budget for our first-year car build.
rows: Tubular steel frame, roll hoops, structural mounts
EMRAX 228 motor, motor controller, cooling system, HV wiring
Accumulator cells, BMS, enclosure, HV safety systems
Double wishbone (front push, rear pull rod), dampers, steering
4 calipers & discs, dual-circuit lines, brake-by-wire compatibility
13" Hoosier tyres, magnesium rims, LSD differential
ECU, TSAL, cockpit instruments, sensors, data acquisition, LV system
Seat, harness, pedals, bodywork, fasteners, cables, hoses

items.title: Team Formation & Concept Design
items.text: Recruit team members, define team structure, begin concept design and establish sponsor relationships.

items.title: Detailed Design Phase
items.text: CAD modelling, FEA simulation, component selection. Each department finalizes their subsystem design.

items.title: Manufacturing
items.text: Fabrication begins in university workshops. Chassis welding, component machining, electronics assembly.

items.title: Assembly & Testing
items.text: Full car assembly, systems integration, shake-down testing, driver training, and tuning.

items.title: Competition
items.text: Formula Student France (Transpolis). Our first time on track, competing against teams from across Europe.

cards.title: Year 1: Concept Class
cards.text: Design and enter FS France concept class with our EV — Project Falcon. Establish team processes and industry partnerships.

cards.title: Year 2: Full Electric Competition
cards.text: Compete with a fully built electric vehicle. Refine the EMRAX 228 powertrain, battery system, and chassis for on-track performance.

cards.title: Autonomous — Someday
cards.text: Long-term vision: enter the driverless category with sensor fusion, machine learning, and autonomous decision-making.
